name: std::chrono::year::ok
intro: Checks if the year value stored in *this is in the valid range, i.e., [-32767, 32767].

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the year value stored in *this is in the range [-32767, 32767]. Otherwise false.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
input year │ internal value │ ok()
      2020 │           2020 │ true
     32768 │         -32768 │ false
     32769 │         -32767 │ true
     65535 │             -1 │ true
     98304 │         -32768 │ false
